input_preprocessing.normalization: Center at bounding-box center; uniformly scale maximum extent to 1.0
input_preprocessing.depth_storage: uint16 millimeters; convert to float32 meters by dividing by 1000

training.query_sampling: Independent uniform indices with replacement from each 100000-query pool

implementation.training_loader: Custom compact NPY loader; independent random query sampling matching upstream
implementation.inference: Construct the official CvxNet model using the supplied model fields, then restore the checkpoint prefix. This is not a Transformers/AutoModel checkpoint. Source code and input meshes are not included.
